items.title: Finiteness of etale cohomology of a constant sheaf with coefficients annihilated by an integer prime to the characteristic, or on a proper curve
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes finiteness of H^q_etale(X, underline M) for a constant coefficient sheaf on a separated finite type curve over an algebraically closed field, in the two cases named in the statement (statement lines 15817-15829). Its content is a chain of explicit reductions (proof lines 15831-15906): first from n to the prime factors of n by a long exact sequence, then from Lambda to Lambda/ell Lambda, then from M to a finite free module by descending induction on q anchored by the vanishing above the dimension of the curve, and finally a basis trick writing underline Lambda as a direct sum of copies of underline F_ell and using that cohomology commutes with direct sums. H2: several standard reductions, each written out, none of them a long construction.
